slots.name: rabies-positive goats
slots.sentence: Farm Adventures said four of its baby goats had contracted rabies and that the animals had been euthanized to prevent further spread.

slots.name: rabies vaccinations
slots.sentence: The CDC said roughly 100,000 Americans receive rabies vaccinations following a potential exposure each year.

slots.name: investigation status
slots.sentence: Organizers of those events are being notified, the agency said, adding that the investigation remains ongoing and additional information about potential exposure locations will be released when available.

slots.name: goat disposition
slots.sentence: In a Facebook statement, Farm Adventures said four of its baby goats had contracted rabies and that the animals had been euthanized to prevent further spread.

slots.name: human rabies cases
slots.sentence: Human rabies infections are extremely rare in the U.S., and no human cases have been reported in North Carolina since 2011, according to NCDHHS.

slots.name: rabies test status
slots.sentence: State health officials said several goats tested positive for rabies at the North Carolina State Laboratory of Public Health.
